audit_items.proof_trace: Cache key depends on state root read from mutable state at line 339. If state_roots array is updated between cache population and lookup, the cache key diverges from actual state, causing cached proposer index to be stale. Falls through to recomputation with new state, but cache remains keyed to old state root.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker triggers concurrent state updates during block processing. State root changes between when cache was populated and when it's queried. Node uses stale cached proposer index from old state root instead of recomputing, accepting block with wrong proposer index.
